# C18 — Apoha

## #0

Apoha enters the essay as constitutive exclusion: a determination becomes this through its relation to what the mark does not apply to. The achieved term carries a field of non-application. Forgetting that field makes the positive mark appear self-sufficient and conceals how it became determinate.

[A08 — Apoha](../A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) **grounds** the argument. C18 preserves the Buddhist semantic office while following the essay's further claim that a determination must retain its source relation. It is not a general name for absence, repression, rejection or every act of negation.

## #1

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/pind/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation.md#^pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation-q001|Pind — PSV V:11d]] **sources** the translated formulation of a word excluding other referents. The nominalist problem concerns how general application works without a real universal which every instance shares. The exclusion supplies an account of reference; it does not by itself establish the essay's whole-first ontology.

The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/siderits/siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha/siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha.md#^siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha-q002|Apoha volume's not-non-pot formulation]] **extends** the semantic structure through its housed secondary transmission. A pot is reached through excluding non-pots. The negative route is part of how the term applies, not an ornamental detour to be discarded after arriving at the positive word.

## #2

The same house's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/siderits/siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha/siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha.md#^siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha-q003|nominally/verbally bound negation distinction]] **qualifies** the operation. Forming an exclusion-term and denying a predication are different acts. Treating their pairing as an ordinary double-negation cancellation would lose the exclusion carried inside the achieved reference. The printed volume's chapter-level reconstruction remains a collation task; the housed distinction is transmitted through scholarship and review.

The earlier `developed Apoha carrier` **sources** the essay's formulation **exclusion that remembers**. Remembering names retention of the constitutive relation, not a claim that every word literally stores an exhaustive catalogue of all excluded objects.

## #3

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/pind/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation.md#^pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation-q002|Pind — qualified preclusion]] **qualifies** the positive side: a thing qualified by preclusion is not mere preclusion. The hare's-horns example marks the difficulty of making an unreal negative object do the whole referential work. This passage is verified as Pind's wording, while his attribution of its underlying fragment remains provisional.

[C03 — Determination](C03-Determination.md) **extends** the question of positive identification. Frank's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity.md|Kripke encounter]] **sources** a live comparative pressure between circumstantial rigidity and exclusion; the comparison with the causally effective particular has not been resolved by equating the traditions. C18 preserves the positive mark and its exclusions together, without making either a self-subsisting remainder.

## #4

The [[quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#16-buddhism-and-śaivism-the-actual-value-judgment|direct Buddhist–Śaiva comparison]] **sources** the authorial pressure behind the transition: comparison and exclusion require present and absent alternatives to be held together, with retained traces available in an act. [C17 — Vikalpa / Saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) **extends** selection and gathering; [C13 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **extends** the reflexive account of that activity.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|Taylor — Core Theorems]], XI, **grounds** the further QL movement from exclusion into a field of differentiation and return. The positive subject-position is not a hidden proprietor behind the excluded contents. The comparative argument retains this distinction while its historical claims keep their own source obligations.

## #5→0


Qualified preclusion does not reduce its referent to mere negation; Pind’s wording is verified while fragment attribution remains provisional; the [language history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md#language-exclusion) **qualifies** this historical attribution.

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-eye-condition): The aperture **figures** the exclusion through which something definite appears. Recognising the withheld relations preserves that productive cut, while exposing a later frame’s unwarranted claim to determine everything real. The image returns this distinction to apoha without replacing its source-specific semantic operations by a camera model or equating constitutive exclusion with missing data.

Choosing the southwest jewel in the [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-native-relation) **figures** a determination that retains its constitutive field. The comparison preserves the difference between semantic non-application in apoha and recursive inclusion in the Huayan image. Their authored braid can carry a selected positive without cancelling the distinct work of negation.

[C40 — Model Internality](C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **tests** a technical account of selection. Relative scores, a normalised distribution and a selected output preserve different information. A bare chosen mark cannot show the alternatives or threshold which materially constituted its choice. The analogy concerns selection and retained context; it does not make normalisation a Buddhist semantic theory.

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Account]] **grounds** the register3 return: the Name is counted against a Region of non-selected possibilities. [C45 — Operational Parity](C45-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** whether retaining a relevant exclusion changes judgment or action. C18 **returns-to** A08: the mark remains determinate while the relation through which it means can be recovered and revised.

**Depth Restoration:** referential exclusion, non-cancelling nominal/verbal distinction, qualified positive referent, retained alternatives and reflexive comparison, and technically distinct selection stages are restored. C18 retains canonical ownership; the lowercase page remains developmental provenance.

**Unresolved Delta:** the Apoha volume's printed chapters and page locators await collation; Pind's preclusion fragment retains provisional attribution. School-specific reconstructions and the rigidity/particularity comparison remain live. The technical bridge is the essay's argued construction, with no experimental or priority claim added here.
